title: US measles cases in 2026 surpass last year's total and set 35-year high
snippet:
As of Thursday, July 23, approximately 2,318 measles cases from 35 separate outbreaks have reached 43 states and Washington, D.C., since the beginning of 2026, according to the CDC, resulting in at least 151 hospitalizations. The majority, 93%, occurred in unvaccinated people, and nearly 69% occurred in children ages 19 and younger. No deaths have been reported. [...] As of July 23, 2026, 2,318 confirmed measles cases were reported in the United States. Just 16 of those were from international travelers. The remaining occurred in 43 states plus Washington, D.C.

## What is measles, and how do you get it? [...] Cases previously reached a 30-year high in 2025, with 2,289 confirmed infections across 43 states plus D.C. for the entire year. Nearly 90% of cases were directly linked to 48 known outbreaks, and 93% of infections were contracted by unvaccinated people or those whose vaccination status was unknown. Three people, including two children, died as a result of the outbreaks, marking the first pediatric death from measles in a decade.

title: US measles cases reach 35-year high, for second record-breaking year in a row | CNN
snippet:
The total number of measles cases in 2026 has already surpassed last year’s total, according to data posted by the CDC on Friday. At least 2,318 cases have been reported with more than five months left in the year. [...] South Carolina has reported more measles cases in 2026 than any other state. An outbreak started raging across Spartanburg County in October; it would become the largest the largest the US has seen in decades, with nearly 1,000 cases, before ending in April this year.

Geographically speaking, the Rev. Scott Neely’s Unitarian Universalist Church of Spartanburg was right in the center of the outbreak. [...] Measles has continued its historic resurgence in the United States this year, with a second record-breaking year in a row. Just over halfway through 2026, the country has recorded more cases than in any other year since 1991 – surpassing a grim milestone that was just topped last year.

The disease was declared eliminated in the US in 2000, but more cases have been recorded in the past 18 months than there have been in the previous 25 years combined.

title: US sees highest number of measles cases in 35 years
snippet:
The US has recorded more measles cases over the past 18 months than the total number over 25 years before that.

The measles virus - with its signature blotchy red rash - used to infect millions of children a year before a vaccine was invented. The extremely contagious virus can be fatal, and some patients can experience long-term complications including encephalitis and immune amnesia, which resets the immune system, leaving it with only limited ability to respond to new infections. [...] # US measles cases reach 35-year high

Getty Images A fact sheet for measles sits on a table with a dark blue tablecloth, in a clipboard

The US has hit a 35-year high in measles cases, according to new figures from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

The US has seen 2,318 confirmed cases of measles in 2026, just seven months into the year, up from last year's high of 2,289, when two unvaccinated children died of the disease. [...] Last year, an outbreak among the Mennonite community in Texas killed two unvaccinated children, and an unvaccinated adult in neighbouring New Mexico.

Over the past month, Virginia and Pennsylvania have been dealing with new measles outbreaks, while the state of Utah is still responding to a cluster of infections that began last year.

Some 45 states have recorded cases.

title: Measles Cases Hit New Record in U.S., as Vaccination Rates Wane - The New York Times
snippet:
The United States has now recorded more cases of measles in 2026 than in any other year since the virus was declared eliminated in 2000, a grim sign that the country may be headed toward a new era in which the disease regularly sickens thousands every year. [...] On Friday, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced that there have been 2,318 confirmed cases of measles so far this year. The case count toppled the record set last year, when measles infected more than 2,200 Americans and killed two unvaccinated children. More measles cases have been reported in the United States in the last two years than in all the years from 2000 through 2024 combined. [...] Measles Outbreaks
